text: Maaɗum golle maɓɓe ɗen ko yeru niɓe e nder maayo luggungo, no dow maggo benpeƴƴe, no dow ɗen benpeƴƴe benpeƴƴe goo, no dow majje duule hiɗe suddi koode tinddinorteeɗe ɗen, niɓe fawondirɗe yoga e majje e dow yoga, si ukkiiɗo e ɗee niɓe ɗoo yaltinii junngo mu'un ngon o ɓadotaako yi'ugol ngo sabu saɗtude niɓe ɗen, ko wano nii kadi yedduɗo on, gomɗii fawondirii e hoore makko niɓe majjere e sikke e wemmbere e uddeede ɓernde makko, on mo Alla arsikaali Peewal immorde e majjere nden, e ganndal ka Deftere Makko, haray o marah peewal ngal o feewita ɗum, wanah kadi deftere nde o ndaygirta ɗum.
